description:
Reid RB250 eBike | 20" Moto-Style Electric Bike
Classic moto-inspired styling meets electric performance in the RB250, a distinctive eBike built for riders who want to make a statement on every journey.
The Reid RB250 combines café racer-inspired styling with practical electric assistance, creating a distinctive alternative to a conventional eBike. Its alloy frame, integrated bench seat and bold moto-style design bring together modern engineering and classic motorcycle influences.
Designed for comfort and confident handling, the RB250 features a dual-crown suspension fork, wide 20" mag-style alloy wheels and 4.0" all-road tyres. The combination provides a stable, comfortable ride across a variety of urban surfaces and everyday routes. Front and rear mudguards add practicality, while the integrated bench seat completes its distinctive look.
An Ananda 250W rear hub motor delivers smooth electric assistance, with 350W peak power and 42Nm of torque to help riders tackle hills and enjoy longer journeys. The 7-speed drivetrain provides flexibility across different routes, with a Shimano rear derailleur and L-TWOO trigger shifter for straightforward gear changes.
The RB250 is available with two battery options to suit different riding requirements. Actual range will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding style.
Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors provide controlled stopping power, while integrated front and rear LED lights help improve visibility. The Ananda D19 colour display features Bluetooth connectivity through the Ananda app, keeping essential ride information close at hand.
Combining distinctive café racer styling, wide tyres and practical electric assistance, the Reid RB250 is designed for riders looking for something different from their everyday eBike.
The RB250 eBike is ideal for:

Riders who want something different, with distinctive café racer-inspired styling and a frame-integrated bench seat

Urban journeys and everyday riding, with smooth assistance from an Ananda 250W rear hub motor

Comfortable riding across varied surfaces, with a dual-crown suspension fork and wide 20 x 4.0" tyres

Tackling different routes, with a versatile 7-speed Shimano drivetrain

Choosing the right range, with two battery options offering up to approximately 60 or 70 miles

Controlled stopping power, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm rotors

Connected ride information, with a colour Ananda display and Bluetooth app connectivity

Everyday practicality, with integrated LED lights, front and rear mudguards and a kickstand

Battery options:

48V 15Ah (720Wh) – EN50604 certified battery, offering an approximate range of up to 70 miles (112km)

48V 12.75Ah (612Wh) – IEC62133 certified battery, offering an approximate range of up to 60 miles (97km)

All range figures are estimates and will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding conditions.
